releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.75 refines Files Search and Notes. The All, Doc, Photo and Video filters now use larger soft illustrated tiles with clearer pastel depth and a stronger selected state, while keeping the same four-filter search behavior and the search field underneath. Search-result previews are larger so PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, photo and video results are easier to recognize at a glance. Saving an important note is now silent: the "Important note saved" snackbar and EMAIL COPY action no longer appear after save. File indexing, Category organization, search scope, note persistence and backup tools are unchanged.
